verdict.rationale: Kino is an agent-driven video editor that exposes an MCP server, so documented skill authoring is a reasonable thing to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions skills, a SKILL.md format, or name/description frontmatter. The '100+ templates' are video titles, maps, captions and transitions. That is a different feature and earns no credit for skill authoring.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
